deploy.help:
digital-employee deploy

  Interactive deployment — one command to get your digital employee running.

  Channels:    DingTalk · Lark · WeCom · Console · HTTP
  AI Engines:  Qoder CLI · Claude Code · Qwen Code · CodeBuddy · OpenAI key
  Languages:   English · 简体中文 · 日本語

Options:
  --channel <id>     Skip channel prompt (dingtalk|lark|wecom|console|http)
  --engine <id>      Skip engine prompt (qoder|claude-code|qwen-code|codebuddy|openai-key)
  --name <name>      Skip bot name prompt
  --locale <code>    Force locale (en|zh-CN|ja)
  --yes              Accept defaults, skip confirmation prompts
  --help             Show this help

Examples:
  digital-employee deploy                          # fully interactive
  digital-employee deploy --channel dingtalk       # skip channel selection
  digital-employee deploy --yes --channel http     # non-interactive HTTP deploy
